package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/endpoint"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/openapi"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/output"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/parameters"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/auth"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/serializers"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/web"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
)

func headerEndpoint(authentication api.Authentication, fields http.Header) (endpoint.Endpoint, error) {
	revision, err := parameters.NewHeader("If-Revision", parameters.Required(parameters.CanonicalInt64(1, 99)), 2, "Row revision.")
	if err != nil {
		return endpoint.Endpoint{}, err
	}
	var exact parameters.Header[int64] = revision
	_, _, err = exact.Parse(fields)
	if err != nil {
		return endpoint.Endpoint{}, err
	}
	_ = exact.MaxBytes()
	var parameter openapi.Parameter = exact.Parameter()
	_ = parameter
	tag, err := parameters.NewHeader("X-Tag", parameters.Optional(parameters.String(16, true)), 16, "")
	if err != nil {
		return endpoint.Endpoint{}, err
	}
	out, err := output.New(output.String(), serializers.Limits{})
	if err != nil {
		return endpoint.Endpoint{}, err
	}
	input := endpoint.NoQuery(endpoint.Sequence(endpoint.Header(exact), endpoint.Header(tag)))
	return endpoint.New(authentication, endpoint.Config[endpoint.Pair[int64, *string], string]{
		Route: web.Route{Name: "consumer:condition", Method: "POST", Path: "/condition/"}, Admission: endpoint.Authenticated(), Input: input, Output: out,
		Success: []endpoint.Status{{Code: 200, Description: "Value."}},
		Handle: func(request *web.Request, _ auth.Principal, value endpoint.Pair[int64, *string]) (output.Prepared[string], error) {
			return out.Prepare(request.Context(), 200, strconv.FormatInt(value.First, 10))
		},
	})
}
